implementation_attempt: Added durable PhaseEvidenceStore integration and close/publish-before-retire logic to src/ops/hot_cold_rollover_runner.py.
real_correctness_failure: Closing a same-run delta before the runner's resumable checkpoint advances makes the next batch route to the deterministic same-run delta filename and attempt to write a CLOSED segment. This raises ColdSegmentImmutabilityViolation.
safety_decision: No supervised production runner execution performed. No cron installed. Tests were not weakened and no workaround was applied.
required_design_fix: Make publication idempotent across resumable batches, e.g. a distinct immutable delta per batch identity with an advanced checkpoint, or a durable recovery path that never reopens a published segment. Requalify all existing resumability tests before production use.
